subject: CAIQ evidence sampling and EU data-residency clarification
messages:
From: Lena Vogt <lena.vogt@acme-fin.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: CAIQ evidence sampling & EU data-residency clarifications

Hi Markus,

Thanks for agreeing to support Acme Financial's CAIQ review. Our security team (CloudAssure) is preparing a focused sampling exercise to validate a subset of your CAIQ answers and the associated artifacts. We have two quick clarifications before we finalize the sampling list: 

1) Data residency scope: our auditor needs confirmation that any customer data for EU accounts is processed and stored only in EU regions or under documented controls for cross-border transfer. Please point us to the CAIQ questions that reference data-location and provide the primary artifact(s) that demonstrate residency (storage config, region tags, dataflow diagram).

2) Retention & logs: we'll sample audit log retention (specifically S3/Blob/Stackdriver retention, any log-shipping to third-party analytics) for controls related to logging and retention. Please include retention policy docs and a small set of sample log manifests.

3) KMS and key ownership: for controls on key management, we need the KM policy and a short note on HSM/KMS type (customer-managed? Redwood-managed?).

Timeline: we aim to run the sampling week of 2026-11-22. Deliverables requested by 2026-11-18 to allow pre-screening.

Attachments we expect: CAIQ responses workbook (filled), an index CSV mapping controls->artifact filenames, and a high-level dataflow diagram. If anything needs redaction, flag it and we can sign an NDA or accept a redacted copy with validation during a walkthrough.

Can you confirm owners and whether the artifacts can be shared via a secure Drive folder (we will provide a service account for download)? Also copy in who will join the walkthrough.

Thanks,
Lena Vogt
Security Manager
Acme Financial

[Attachment suggestion: sample-evidence-request.pdf]

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Lena Vogt <lena.vogt@acme-fin.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: CAIQ evidence sampling & EU data-residency clarifications

Lena — thanks for the clear ask. Looping in Kimberly (Control-owner for Data & Storage) and Priyom (Platform compliance) to assemble the artifacts.

Plan / owners: 
- Kimberly: will own the CAIQ workbook updates and the evidence-index CSV.
- Priyom: will provide the dataflow diagram and a short write-up on region tagging and KMS configuration.
- Markus (me): will coordinate access and attestations; handle any NDA/DocuSign if redaction is necessary.

Deliverables we will upload to a secure Drive folder by COB 2026-11-18: 
- caiq_responses_v2.xlsx (completed responses + control notes)
- evidence-index.csv (control_id, artifact_name, owner, redaction_flag)
- dataflow-diagram.png (annotated)
- small log-sample-manifest.txt (metadata only; actual logs will be provided in zipped, redacted form if required)

Quick clarifications: 
- Residency: EU customer data is stored in our eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 clusters; for some ephemeral processing we use replicated caches in us-east for performance with encryption and contractual transfer protections. Priyom will document the exact flows and controls (we will call out any cross-border transfer controls in the CAIQ answers).
- KMS: Redwood uses a hybrid model — platform-managed keys for default encrypt-at-rest, with customer-managed KMS available for Dedicated/Private deployments. For hosted Acme accounts (you flagged as EU), keys are platform-managed with strict access controls; we will include the KMS policy and key rotation notes.

If CloudAssure needs a signed NDA for viewing redacted artifacts, send the template and I'll push it through DocuSign.

Markus
Markus Klein | Director, Trust & Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Access method: we will provision a read-only folder at https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3C-secure-share (we will add CloudAssure service-account email once you provide it). DocuSign link will be used for the NDA if needed: https://app.docusign.com/doc/ABC123-review

Small point on evidence scope: please confirm whether CloudAssure needs sample artifacts for both eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 or a single EU region is sufficient for your sampling plan. We can do both but it increases prep time.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Security Controls Lead, Redwood Inference
